sn45.30:1.2: Then the Venerable Uttiya approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn45.30:1.3: “Here, venerable sir, when I was alone in seclusion a reflection arose in my mind thus:
sn45.30:1.4: ‘Five cords of sensual pleasure have been spoken of by the Blessed One. But what now are those five cords of sensual pleasure?’”
sn45.30:1.7: These five cords of sensual pleasure have been spoken of by me.
sn45.30:1.9: Forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn45.30:1.13: Tactile objects cognizable by the body that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn45.30:1.14: These are the five cords of sensual pleasure spoken of by me.
sn45.30:1.15: “The Noble Eightfold Path, Uttiya, is to be developed for the abandoning of these five cords of sensual pleasure.
sn45.30:1.16: And what is the Noble Eightfold Path?
sn45.30:1.17: It is: right view … right concentration.
sn45.30:1.18: This Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for the abandoning of these five cords of sensual pleasure.”
